verdict.rationale: n8n's official repository advertises 1500+ integrations. Its docs host a large built-in node and credentials catalog (Asana, Datadog, GitHub, Okta and more) plus an integrations directory, and pricing says every plan includes every integration. A hands-on user confirms they rely on n8n so they don't have to build and maintain API integrations themselves. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the built-in integrations are vendor-maintained (only implied by the 'builtin' docs namespace), and evidence on per-integration depth and documentation quality (one user reports the Kafka trigger doc page is empty).

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: All plans include unlimited users & workflows and every integration.
One reason is not having to build and maintain integrations with lots of APIs for workflows that are just run once in a while
